children: Protector Forsikring ASA, rated A- (Excellent) with Stable outlook from AM Best, has today successfully issued a new NOK 350 million Solvency II compliant Perpetual Restricted Tier 1 bond pricing at 3m NIBOR + 2.25% p.a.
First call option will be on 17 September 2031, five years after the settlement date. The bond will qualify as a Restricted Tier 1 Instrument for the issuer for the purpose of applicable regulations.
Settlement date for the new issue is expected to be 17 September 2026.
The new bond issue will be applied for listing at Oslo Børs.
Nordea acted as Sole Manager for the bond issue.
Chief Financial Officer Amund Grønvold Skoglund, Tel: +47 472 70 355

title: PROTECTOR FORSIKRING ASA SUCCESSFUL PLACEMENT OF NEW PERPETUAL RESTRICTED TIER 1 BOND ISSUE
